definitions.explanation: A plate or sign displaying the resident's name at the entrance of a home.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{表札|ひょうさつ}を{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
{表札|ひょうさつ}を{見|み}て{住所|じゅうしょ}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I confirmed the address by looking at the nameplate.

examples.japanese: {木製|もくせい}の{表札|ひょうさつ}が{素敵|すてき}だ。

notes: A traditional feature of Japanese homes, though less common on apartments. Can be made of wood, metal, or ceramic. Some people choose not to display one for privacy.
